resources.string: Install the Apple TV Cleaner APK to use the power menu.

Select your original home to stop using Apple TV Launcher as Home, or Apple TV Launcher to switch back. The original launcher must be enabled and your TV must provide a home picker; use the restore script first if it was disabled.
This name appears in the welcome message.
Adds a lifted tile, icon zoom and smooth colour transitions. May increase memory use; the actual difference depends on your TV.
Experimental: Liquid Glass decorates focused Home, app and settings controls. Android 11 and older use the lightweight glass fallback because CPU blur misses the responsiveness target.
Optional outlines for visible controls in other apps. This service draws only; it does not capture touch or keys. Enable it in Android Accessibility settings and keep Liquid Glass enabled.
Draws outlines around visible clickable controls in other apps. Does not intercept touch or keys.
Uses the current theme or built-in layout and motion settings. Pushing or resetting a theme also clears your on-TV choices.
Choose which controls appear on the Controls page.
Opens the input switcher when the remote\'s Input button is pressed.
Makes the remote\'s Home button open this launcher; a double press opens the app switcher.
%1$s can show a card on your home screen. Keeping it hidden leaves the app\'s normal tile as it is.
The card is named \'%1$s\'. The app is \'%2$s\'.
%1$s was updated with a different signing key, so your earlier answer no longer applies. Decide again for its card.
%1$s changed the name of its card since you decided. Decide again for it.
You can change this later: hold OK on Settings, then choose Module cards.
Choose how to hide the player.
Keep the background and hide only the Dock tile
Hide the player and its background
Remember this choice for next time

Android notification access can expose notifications from all apps. The launcher uses it only to query active media sessions for track details and playback controls; it does not read message contents or intercept remote keys. You can revoke access in TV settings.

This Fire TV does not provide an Android notification-access settings page. Enabling access through ADB grants the launcher visibility into notifications from all apps; the launcher only queries active media sessions.
Seeking is not available for this playback.
The current player has not supplied lyrics for this track.
Android requires microphone/audio permission so the equalizer can analyze the Fire TV audio output. Audio levels are analyzed on this device only; audio is not recorded, saved, or sent anywhere.
Audio permission was not granted, so the equalizer cannot react to playback.
This TV does not provide audio-output levels to the equalizer.
LRCLIB has no synchronized lyrics for this track.
Could not load lyrics from LRCLIB. Check the TV’s internet connection and try again.
LRCLIB is temporarily limiting or pausing requests. Try again in %1$d seconds.
Waiting for the next lyric line…
This track is marked as instrumental.
Musixmatch requires an API key. You can also choose Genius (opens its website) or player-provided lyrics in Settings. Track title and artist are sent to Musixmatch only when that source is selected.
No Musixmatch API key is configured. Opening the Genius search in the launcher.
No licensed lyrics are available for this track.
Could not load lyrics. Check your internet connection and Musixmatch API key.
Musixmatch request failed (HTTP %1$d). Check the API key and try again.
Enter your API key. It is encrypted on this device; track title and artist are sent to Musixmatch for each lyrics lookup.
Your key is stored encrypted on this device. Enter a key to add or replace it. Lyrics are shown only when Musixmatch provides the required copyright and view-tracking data.
Could not securely read or save the Musixmatch API key.

LRCLIB uses a free public API. When the expanded player opens, a lookup sends the track title, artist, album and duration to LRCLIB; lyrics are shown from memory only, not saved to disk, and remain copyrighted. Genius opens its website; Musixmatch needs an API key.
Genius could not be loaded. Check the TV’s internet connection and try again.
Playback could not be resumed after changing audio output.
Choose a Bluetooth speaker paired with this Fire TV, or move Spotify playback to another Spotify Connect device.
Fire TV Bluetooth settings are not available on this device.
Change Bluetooth audio output in Fire TV settings.
Spotify did not confirm that the playlist was created.
Remove added track from this playlist
Add current track to a playlist
Spotify did not provide a track link for this song.
Spotify needs playlist access. Reconnect and approve the requested permissions.
Create a Spotify Developer app, add the redirect URI below, then enter its Client ID. No client secret is needed. Moving playback requires Spotify Premium.
Set up / sign in to Spotify
Add this exact Redirect URI to your Spotify Developer app first:\n%1$s
Set your Client ID, then sign in with Spotify.
No Spotify Connect devices are available. Open Spotify on another device first.
Choose a device to move playback. Spotify Premium is required.
Spotify authorization removed from this launcher.
This speaker was discovered locally, but Spotify does not accept its device ID for playback transfer (HTTP 404). The launcher will not send a failing transfer request.
This removes the saved Spotify authorization from the launcher.
Spotify denied playback transfer. Check Premium status and the Developer app API access.
Spotify playback could not be controlled. Check the connection and active device.
Spotify is temporarily rate-limiting requests. Try again shortly.
Could not securely read or save Spotify authorization data.
On Fire OS 7 this adjusts the translucent sheen and edge glow. Android 9 does not provide live backdrop blur to ordinary apps.
No networks found. Check that Wi-Fi and location are enabled, then scan again.
Location permission is required to scan for Wi-Fi networks.
The TV did not accept this network connection. You can still view networks here, but this Fire OS version may restrict connections from apps.
Only titles that do not fit scroll; higher values move faster.
This launcher does not manage AirPlay or HomeKit. Use the TV settings for features supported by your device.
These are optional launcher accessibility services. Tap a row to open Android Accessibility settings; you must enable each service there.
The equalizer reads audio levels on this TV only. Tap the row above to request Android\'s microphone/audio permission; Android will ask you to confirm.
Opens the system power menu. Choose Power off or Sleep there.
To show the TV power menu, enable “TV power controls” in Accessibility settings, then return and select Turn off TV again.
Could not open the TV power menu.
Allows the launcher to open the system power menu when you select Turn off TV.
Use the D-pad to move through categories and settings. Press OK to open or change an item; Back returns to the previous screen.

Apple TV Launcher is an independent launcher and is not affiliated with Apple, Amazon, Spotify, Netflix, or Google. Those names are trademarks of their respective owners. Media access is used only for active playback information.

Settings are now grouped into categories. You can manage apps and folders, customize the Home layout and appearance, choose a lyrics source, configure Spotify Connect, and restore the launcher defaults from System.
Opens the launcher\'s full-screen clock preview.

Resets launcher data such as layout, favorites, folders, language, account name, Spotify sign-in, Musixmatch API key, and history. Installed apps, TV settings, and the system\'s default Home app stay unchanged.
Restores the launcher to its built-in defaults. Installed apps and TV system settings are not changed.
Some launcher data could not be reset. Check storage permissions and try again.
Select apps to add or remove them from the Home Dock. Hide apps, reorder the list, or group non-Dock apps into folders. Move Dock apps with Left/Right in jiggle mode.
Jiggle mode: move with Left/Right. Press OK or Back to finish editing.
Select at least two apps that are not in the Dock or another folder.
The folder could not be saved. Please try again.
There are no folders to manage.
Delete “%1$s”? Its apps will return to the grid.
Could not stop the app process.
Could not start the uninstall flow.
This item cannot be resumed directly by the streaming app.
Select one or more apps first.
The Home Dock is full; some selected apps could not be added.
Show hidden apps before adding them to a folder.
Turn the Fire TV Home redirect off here. To turn it on, enable the Apple Home Switcher in Accessibility settings, then return here.
Enable the Apple Home Switcher in Accessibility settings. If those settings are unavailable, the helper app shows ADB setup steps.
Install the Apple Home Switcher helper app first.
Set up your Apple TV launcher.
Choose the name shown in your greeting.
You can change this later in Settings.
Pick a Home background. You can change it anytime.
Use a scenic background with a calm evening look.
Use the classic Apple TV banner background.
Choose which controls appear in the Quick Panel.
Review your Fire TV Home and accessibility settings.
Choose Apple TV Launcher as your default Home app if Fire OS allows it.
Enable Apple Home Switcher to handle the remote Home button.
Set up how your remote opens Home, Quick Controls, and the app switcher.
Enable Apple Home Switcher in Accessibility settings. On supported remotes, Home opens Apple TV Launcher, a quick double-press opens the app switcher, and Settings opens Quick Controls.
Open Accessibility settings to enable or review the Home key service.
These settings are not available on this Fire TV.
Use the dark appearance for Home and Settings.
Use the light appearance for Home and Settings.
Choose how many apps to show and pick the apps for your Dock.
No TV apps are installed yet. You can add apps to the Dock later in Apps.
Choose up to %1$d apps for the Dock.
The TV keyboard could not be opened. Check the installed input method and try again.
Connect Spotify to show playback on Home and in the player.
Sign in with Spotify Connect to enable the Home player.
Spotify is connected. Open this page again to choose a playback device.
The player appears when Spotify Connect playback is active. Spotify setup asks for your Spotify Client ID and opens Spotify sign-in.
Choose whether to use your location or pick a city.
Location permission is needed to use your current location.
Select a city for your weather preference.
Use a paired PC to apply the required Fire TV permissions.
A regular TV app cannot grant protected Fire OS permissions by itself. Use the paired PC installer for automatic ADB setup, or choose Manual Setup to open Accessibility settings.
Open Fire TV settings and enable the required services yourself.
Open Accessibility settings to enable the Home button service.
Weather forecast data is not configured in this launcher yet.
Use the heart, player, and add controls in the Quick Panel.

Scan this QR code with a phone on the same Wi-Fi network. Submit direct APK links on the phone. Only an APK for this launcher signed with the installed signing key is accepted; Android will ask you to confirm installation on the TV.
Enter the PIN shown below on your phone. The session ends when you leave this screen and expires after 10 minutes without activity.
Waiting for APK links from your phone…
%1$d compatible launcher update(s) verified. Choose one on your phone.
This update session expired. Start a new session.
Could not start the local update session. Check the Wi-Fi connection and try again.
Android requires you to allow this launcher to request updates. Open the system setting and approve it; Android will still show a confirmation before installing each update.
The update was not installed. You can try another link or start a new session.
Could not open Android’s installer for this verified APK.
Could not open Android’s installation settings.
Scan this code to open the local launcher update page.
Connect to the TV using the six-digit PIN. Submit up to five direct APK links; only a launcher APK with the installed signing key can be selected. Android will ask for confirmation on the TV.
Direct APK links, one per line

Use HTTPS or a direct HTTP address on the same Wi-Fi. GitHub Releases download links are supported (for example, https://github.com/owner/repo/releases/latest/download/launcher.apk); do not use a release or file preview page. Up to five links are checked.
Enter the six-digit PIN shown on the TV.
Incorrect PIN. Check the TV screen and try again.
This session expired. Return to the TV and start a new one.
No compatible launcher APK was found.
Android’s installation confirmation is opening on the TV. Complete or cancel it there.
Something went wrong. Return to the TV and start a new session.
Compatible launcher APK; signing key verified.
Opening Android’s installation confirmation on the TV…
Enter between one and five links.
This link is invalid, duplicated, or not allowed on the TV Wi-Fi.
Links were already submitted. Start a new session on the TV to try again.
This file could not be verified as a launcher APK.
Could not download or verify this APK. Check the link, version, and signing key.
This APK is not ready to install. Wait for verification to finish.
